race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
race.verdict: MASSIMO BLUE has thrived for the switch to Dylan Cunha and is fancied to garner a fourth success for the yard on the back of an unlucky C&D second. Angel Love also arrives on the up and is feared most in her bid for a second C&D victory, while Itsatenfromlen and Dandy Magic can also play a prominent role. MASSIMO BLUE ANGEL LOVE ITSATENFROMLEN
